tour.welcomeDescription: Welcome to the tutorial of Eurostat's Energy Prices visualisation Tool. This guided tour will show you the main ways of interacting with the tool.
tour.languageDescription: Use this option to change the language of the tool. It supports English, French, and German.
tour.menuDescription: In addition to the bar options, the tool contains a menu for additional features. Click on the menu icon to customize the chart. Click next to learn about the menu options.
tour.insightsDescription: Open a summary of the data shown in this view.
tour.shareDescription: If you find this visualisation tool useful, please show your support by sharing it with others on X, Facebook, email, and LinkedIn. Thank you!
tour.downloadDescription: Click here to download chart or data.
tour.toolDescription: The title and subtitle describe what you are looking at.
tour.replayDescription: Use this button whenever you want to see this tour again.
tour.contentDescription: The charts and data of the tool appear here.
tour.chartDescription: The height of these bars represents the prices that customers pay for gas or electricity. By clicking on them, you can further disaggregate them into sub-categories or explore other statistics such as time graphs, pie charts, or bar charts to compare different consumption levels for the selected country.
tour.tableDescription: Use this option to change the chart to a table format.
tour.orderDescription: Use this option to change the order of the chart elements.
tour.aggregatesDescription: Use this option to add or remove aggregates from the chart.
tour.componentsDescription: Use this option to change to components mode.
tour.detailsDescription: Use this option to see in details.
tour.embedDescription: Use this button to embed the chart in other tools or websites.

insights.title: Energy prices insights
insights.heading: Indicators at a glance
insights.intro: This view summarises the data of the tool. Values keep their original units and should not be compared directly across different units.
insights.coverageText: The current view combines several countries, country groups and units.
insights.groupsText: The countries of the view, grouped as in the filters.
insights.readIntro: The overview describes direction and leading contributors, not a single indicator.
insights.risingText: the latest value is moving up versus earlier years.
insights.fallingText: the latest value is moving down versus earlier years.
insights.stableText: no clear increase or decrease is detected.
insights.takeaway1: {{countries}} countries in {{groups}} groups are available in this view.
insights.takeaway2: {{units}} units are configured: do not compare values across different units.
insights.takeaway3: Compare total prices and tax components across countries and periods.
insights.noData: There is no data to analyse with the selected filters.
insights.noValue: No price is available for {{country}} in {{period}}.

position.title: Position among countries
position.rank: Ranks {{rank}} of {{n}} countries, where 1 is the highest price.
position.percentile: More expensive than {{percent}} % of the countries.
position.median: {{gap}} compared with the median of the countries ({{median}}).
position.ea: {{gap}} compared with the euro area price.
position.outlierHigh: The price is unusually high compared with the other countries.
position.outlierLow: The price is unusually low compared with the other countries.
position.sensitive: The rank could easily change: the nearest countries are within 2 % ({{list}}).
position.persistentHigh: The price was in the top quarter of countries in {{share}} % of the last {{periods}} periods.
position.persistentLow: The price was in the bottom quarter of countries in {{share}} % of the last {{periods}} periods.
position.regional: In {{region}} it ranks {{rank}} of {{size}}, {{gap}} compared with the regional average.

rankShift.higherInPps: Adjusted for purchasing power the price ranks higher ({{rankPps}} of {{cohort}}) than in euro ({{rankEur}}).
rankShift.lowerInPps: Adjusted for purchasing power the price ranks lower ({{rankPps}} of {{cohort}}) than in euro ({{rankEur}}).
rankShift.similar: The rank is similar in euro ({{rankEur}}) and in purchasing power ({{rankPps}}) among {{cohort}} countries.

development.title: Development over time
development.year: {{change}} compared with the same period a year earlier ({{period}}).

momentum.risingAccelerating: Prices are rising and the rise is speeding up ({{latest}} over the year, against {{previous}} before).
momentum.risingSlowing: Prices are still rising, but more slowly ({{latest}} over the year, against {{previous}} before).
momentum.fallingAccelerating: Prices are falling and the fall is speeding up ({{latest}} over the year, against {{previous}} before).
momentum.fallingSlowing: Prices are still falling, but more slowly ({{latest}} over the year, against {{previous}} before).
momentum.reversal: The yearly trend has turned around ({{latest}} over the year, against {{previous}} before).

streak.increase: The price has risen for {{count}} periods in a row.
streak.decrease: The price has fallen for {{count}} periods in a row.

development.volatility: Volatility over the last {{periods}} periods: {{value}} percentage points (standard deviation of the changes between periods).
development.lifetime: {{change}} since {{start}}; the price is now {{multiplier}} times the first value.

reversal.rising: After several rises, the price has just fallen.
reversal.falling: After several falls, the price has just risen.

development.seasonal: The second half of the year is typically {{typical}} compared with the first (over {{years}} years).
development.highRegime: {{share}} % of the periods were in the top fifth of prices ({{price}} or more).
development.crisisPeak: Since the 2021–2023 peak ({{peak}}), the price has changed by {{change}}.
development.crisisBefore: Compared with {{period}}, before the crisis, the price is {{change}}.

history.title: Historical position
history.newHigh: This is the highest price on record.
history.newLow: This is the lowest price on record.
history.peak: The peak was {{value}} in {{period}}; the price is now {{gap}} from it.
history.nearHigh: The price is within 5 % of its record high.
history.nearLow: The price is within 5 % of its record low.
history.percentile: Higher than {{percent}} % of the {{count}} periods on record.

europe.title: Across Europe
europe.counts: Over the year, prices rose in {{rising}} countries, fell in {{falling}} and stayed stable in {{stable}}.

dispersion.converging: Prices across countries are moving closer together.
dispersion.diverging: Prices across countries are moving further apart.
dispersion.stable: The gap between countries is about the same as a year ago.

composition.title: What the price is made of
composition.dominant: {{name}} makes up more than half of the price.
composition.taxShare: Taxes and VAT are {{share}} % of the price, {{delta}} percentage points compared with a year earlier.

fiscal.title: Effect of taxes and levies
fiscal.change: Over the year the price before taxes changed by {{pre}} and the final price by {{final}}.
fiscal.cushioned: Taxes and levies softened the rise in the final price.
fiscal.amplified: Taxes and levies made the rise in the final price larger.
fiscal.offsetDecrease: Taxes and levies reduced the fall in the final price.
fiscal.oppositeUp: The price before taxes fell, but the final price rose because of taxes and levies.
fiscal.oppositeDown: The price before taxes rose, but the final price fell because of taxes and levies.
fiscal.neutral: Taxes and levies had no clear effect on the change.

bands.title: By consumption band

pattern.flat: The price is almost the same in every consumption band.
pattern.decreasing: The price falls as consumption grows.
pattern.increasing: The price rises as consumption grows.
pattern.mixed: The price does not change in one direction as consumption grows.

bands.gap: {{gap}} in the selected band ({{band}}) compared with the standard band.

spread.widened: The gap between the smallest and the largest band widened over the year ({{spread}}).
spread.narrowed: The gap between the smallest and the largest band narrowed over the year ({{spread}}).
spread.stable: The gap between the smallest and the largest band is about the same as a year ago ({{spread}}).

cost.label: Your yearly consumption ({{unit}})
cost.hint: Enter a yearly consumption to estimate the cost.
cost.result: At {{consumption}} the price band is {{band}}: about {{cost}} a year.
cost.none: There is no price for that consumption.

components.title: Annual price components
components.dominant: {{name}} explains most of the yearly change.
components.versusEu: Compared with the EU, {{name}} differs most: {{focus}} % of the price against {{eu}} %.

context.title: Context
context.inflation: Energy prices changed by {{energy}} over the year, while consumer prices overall changed by {{hicp}}.
context.crossFuel: Per kWh, electricity costs {{ratio}} times as much as natural gas ({{electricity}} against {{gas}}).

quality.title: About the data
quality.estimated: The latest value is an estimate.
quality.negativePrice: The latest price is negative, which is unusual.
quality.zeroPrice: The latest price is zero, which is unusual.
quality.implausibleChange: The yearly change is very large; check the data before relying on it.
quality.noComponents: There are no annual component figures for this country.
quality.smallGroup: Only {{n}} countries have a price, so comparisons are less reliable.
quality.shortHistory: Only {{count}} periods are available, so trends are less reliable.
